budget.policy: Stop on errors or time budget, preserve partial outputs; incomplete cohorts prohibit adoption; no silent truncation

protocol.cache_policy: One explicit training fixed cache shared A0 then A2; standalone estimates add cached fit_seconds, never claim cold measurement

decision.default: D1 retain v5.1 unless all gates pass; D2 candidate requires final user approval
decision.correctness: Complete 100 paired datasets, manifest and OLS audits, grid/cap invariants, regression checks; no failures
decision.primary: 90 low-correlation datasets equally weighted by scenario; correlation stress is separate safety gate
decision.uncertainty: Five repetitions per scenario support broad paired screening, not definitive scenario-wise statistical claims; keep interval and cap limitations explicit

bootstrap.unit: paired dataset, resample within scenario preserving equal scenario weights

protocol.msic_policy: Keep original MSIC unless A2 search adopted and separate A2-pool controlled evidence warrants independent confirmation; A3 ablation cannot approve A2 rule
